text.tspan: Encapsulation: how curl http://10.0.2.15/health is wrapped before it leaves
The L2 frame is thrown away and rebuilt with new MACs.
The IP addresses stay the same end to end
Router / NAT / security group: up to L3–L4 (IP, port)
ALB / ingress / proxy: up to L7 (host, path, headers)
